## Importing transcribed compass points and tree measurements

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
por_compass_df<-read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Poria_survey_70s.xlsx", sheet = "Poria_compass_points", range = "A1:AP83", col_names = TRUE)
#por_compass_df<-read_excel("C:/Users/showalt_d/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Poria_survey_70s.xlsx", sheet = "Poria_compass_points", range = "A1:AP83", col_names = TRUE)
#subset four compass points for testing including some with "C" and negative numbers
#compass_test<-por_compass_df[c(1:4, 35:37),]

#convert bearings to fill in missing azimuths

por_compass_df$bear_ref_1<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))

#determining weather to add or subtract the degree adjustment
por_compass_df$add_1<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_1 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_1 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_1 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_1 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_1 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_1 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
#run the calculation
por_compass_df$Az_1_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$add_1==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_1 + por_compass_df$Deg_1 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(por_compass_df$add_1==FALSE, # if false, 
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_1 - por_compass_df$Deg_1 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))
#convert neg degerees to pos
por_compass_df$Az_1_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Az_1_calc <0 , 360 + por_compass_df$Az_1_calc, por_compass_df$Az_1_calc)

#replacing missing azimuths with calculated (if available)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_1 <- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$Azimuth_1), por_compass_df$Az_1_calc,por_compass_df$Azimuth_1)

#repeat for 2-4
por_compass_df$bear_ref_2<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
por_compass_df$add_2<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_2 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_2 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_2 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_2 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_2 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_2 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
por_compass_df$Az_2_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$add_2==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_2 + por_compass_df$Deg_2 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(por_compass_df$add_2==FALSE, # if false, 
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_2 - por_compass_df$Deg_2 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
por_compass_df$Az_2_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Az_2_calc <0 , 360 + por_compass_df$Az_2_calc, por_compass_df$Az_2_calc)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_2 <- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$Azimuth_2), por_compass_df$Az_2_calc,por_compass_df$Azimuth_2)
por_compass_df$bear_ref_3<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
por_compass_df$add_3<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_3 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_3 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_3 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_3 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_3 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_3 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
por_compass_df$Az_3_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$add_3==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_3 + por_compass_df$Deg_3 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(por_compass_df$add_3==FALSE, # if false, 
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_3 - por_compass_df$Deg_3 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
por_compass_df$Az_3_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Az_3_calc <0 , 360 + por_compass_df$Az_3_calc, por_compass_df$Az_3_calc)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_3 <- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$Azimuth_3), por_compass_df$Az_3_calc,por_compass_df$Azimuth_3)
por_compass_df$bear_ref_4<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="N", #test is north
                              0 #if yes, then 0 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="E", #test is east
                                     90 #if yes, then 90 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="S", #test is south
                                     180 #if yes, then 180 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="W", #test is west
                                     270 #if yes, then 270 deg
                              , #if not, then
                              NA #fill as NA since there is nothing in "direction" field
                              ))))
por_compass_df$add_4<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="N", #test dir is north
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_4 =="E", # if dir north, then test adj is east
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is east then add, if not then subtract  
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="E", #if not north then test dir is east
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_4 =="E",# if dir east, then test adj is south
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is south then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="S", #if not east then test dir is south
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_4 =="W",# if dir south, then test adj is west
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                            , ifelse(por_compass_df$Dir_4 =="W", #if not south then test dir is west
                           ifelse(por_compass_df$Adj_4 =="N",# if dir west, then test adj is north
                              TRUE, FALSE) #if adj is west then add, if not then subtract
                           , NA #if Dir_4 is not NESW then return NA
                           ))))
por_compass_df$Az_4_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$add_4==TRUE,  #if add is TRUE
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_4 + por_compass_df$Deg_4 #then add deg to ref
                                , ifelse(por_compass_df$add_4==FALSE, # if false, 
                                por_compass_df$bear_ref_4 - por_compass_df$Deg_4 # then subtract deg from ref
                                , NA # if neither TRUE nor FALSE, then NA
                                ))  
por_compass_df$Az_4_calc<- ifelse(por_compass_df$Az_4_calc <0 , 360 + por_compass_df$Az_4_calc, por_compass_df$Az_4_calc)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_4 <- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$Azimuth_4), por_compass_df$Az_4_calc,por_compass_df$Azimuth_4)



#first change "C" Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4 to "0"
por_compass_df$Y_1 <- as.double(ifelse(por_compass_df$Y_1 == "C", "0", por_compass_df$Y_1))
por_compass_df$Y_2 <- as.double(ifelse(por_compass_df$Y_2 == "C", "0", por_compass_df$Y_2))
por_compass_df$Y_3 <- as.double(ifelse(por_compass_df$Y_3 == "C", "0", por_compass_df$Y_3))
por_compass_df$Y_4 <- as.double(ifelse(por_compass_df$Y_4 == "C", "0", por_compass_df$Y_4))

#make sure xs, ys, azimuths, distances are dbl not chr
#glimpse(por_compass_df)
por_compass_df$X_1 <- as.double(por_compass_df$X_1)
por_compass_df$Y_1 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Y_1)
por_compass_df$Y_2 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Y_2)
por_compass_df$Dist_2 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Dist_2)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_2 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Azimuth_2)
por_compass_df$X_3 <- as.double(por_compass_df$X_3)
por_compass_df$Y_3 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Y_3)
por_compass_df$Dist_3 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Dist_3)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_3 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Azimuth_3)
por_compass_df$X_4 <- as.double(por_compass_df$X_4)
por_compass_df$Y_4 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Y_4)
por_compass_df$Dist_4 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Dist_4)
por_compass_df$Azimuth_4 <- as.double(por_compass_df$Azimuth_4)
#glimpse(por_compass_df)

#then convert chain grid to computer grid
por_compass_df$comp_X_1 <- (-(por_compass_df$X_1 /2))+17 
por_compass_df$comp_X_2 <- (-(por_compass_df$X_2 /2))+17 
por_compass_df$comp_X_3 <- (-(por_compass_df$X_3 /2))+17 
por_compass_df$comp_X_4 <- (-(por_compass_df$X_4 /2))+17 

por_compass_df$comp_Y_1 <- (por_compass_df$Y_1 + 10) /2
por_compass_df$comp_Y_2 <- (por_compass_df$Y_2 + 10) /2
por_compass_df$comp_Y_3 <- (por_compass_df$Y_3 + 10) /2
por_compass_df$comp_Y_4 <- (por_compass_df$Y_4 + 10) /2

#create a distance grid measured in feet, based on the computer grid
por_compass_df$ft_X_1 <- por_compass_df$comp_X_1 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_X_2 <- por_compass_df$comp_X_2 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_X_3 <- por_compass_df$comp_X_3 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_X_4 <- por_compass_df$comp_X_4 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_Y_1 <- por_compass_df$comp_Y_1 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_Y_2 <- por_compass_df$comp_Y_2 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_Y_3 <- por_compass_df$comp_Y_3 * 132
por_compass_df$ft_Y_4 <- por_compass_df$comp_Y_4 * 132

#calculate slope-corrected horizontal distances if necessary
por_compass_df$Dist_1_cor<- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$'%_1'), por_compass_df$Dist_1, por_compass_df$Dist_1*cos(atan(por_compass_df$'%_1' /100)))
por_compass_df$Dist_2_cor<- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$'%_2'), por_compass_df$Dist_2, por_compass_df$Dist_2*cos(atan(por_compass_df$'%_2' /100)))
por_compass_df$Dist_3_cor<- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$'%_3'), por_compass_df$Dist_3, por_compass_df$Dist_3*cos(atan(por_compass_df$'%_3' /100)))
por_compass_df$Dist_4_cor<- ifelse(is.na(por_compass_df$'%_4'), por_compass_df$Dist_4, por_compass_df$Dist_4*cos(atan(por_compass_df$'%_4' /100)))


#REVERSE (180) THE BEARINGS SINCE THE MEASUREMENT WAS FROM THE COMPASS TO THE GRID AND X-positive on Grid is 225 relative to north. SO NET IS - 45
por_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip <-por_compass_df$Azimuth_1 -45
por_compass_df$Azimuth_2_flip <-por_compass_df$Azimuth_2 -45
por_compass_df$Azimuth_3_flip <-por_compass_df$Azimuth_3 -45
por_compass_df$Azimuth_4_flip <-por_compass_df$Azimuth_4 -45

```

#Converting from polar to cartesian coordinate and plotting 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Calculate cartesian coordinates for compass stations relative to ft grid (convert compass station chain coords to ft grid)

#calculation cartesian coordinates for tree relative to compass stations
#see this post for converting bearing and distance (polar) to Cartesian coordinates
#https://www.r-bloggers.com/2007/10/convert-polar-coordinates-to-cartesian/
por_compass_df$loc_X_1 <- por_compass_df$ft_X_1+por_compass_df$Dist_1_cor*sin(por_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_Y_1 <- por_compass_df$ft_Y_1+por_compass_df$Dist_1_cor*cos(por_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_X_2 <- por_compass_df$ft_X_2+por_compass_df$Dist_2_cor*sin(por_compass_df$Azimuth_2_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_Y_2 <- por_compass_df$ft_Y_2+por_compass_df$Dist_2_cor*cos(por_compass_df$Azimuth_2_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_X_3 <- por_compass_df$ft_X_3+por_compass_df$Dist_3_cor*sin(por_compass_df$Azimuth_3_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_Y_3 <- por_compass_df$ft_Y_3+por_compass_df$Dist_3_cor*cos(por_compass_df$Azimuth_3_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_X_4 <- por_compass_df$ft_X_4+por_compass_df$Dist_4_cor*sin(por_compass_df$Azimuth_4_flip*pi/180)
por_compass_df$loc_Y_4 <- por_compass_df$ft_Y_4+por_compass_df$Dist_4_cor*cos(por_compass_df$Azimuth_4_flip*pi/180)

por_compass_df$ft_X_ave = rowMeans(por_compass_df[c("loc_X_1", "loc_X_2", "loc_X_3","loc_X_4")], na.rm=TRUE)
por_compass_df$ft_Y_ave = rowMeans(por_compass_df[c("loc_Y_1", "loc_Y_2", "loc_Y_3","loc_Y_4")], na.rm=TRUE)
```

#importing recorded cut stump compass points
```{r, echo=FALSE}
cut_compass_df<-read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Poria_survey_70s.xlsx", sheet = "Cut_stump_compass_points", range = "A1:G43", col_names = TRUE)
#glimpse(cut_compass_df)
#first change "C" "0"
cut_compass_df$Y_1 <- as.double(ifelse(cut_compass_df$Y_1 == "C", "0", cut_compass_df$Y_1))
#then convert chain grid to computer grid
cut_compass_df$comp_X_1 <- (-(cut_compass_df$X_1 /2))+17 
cut_compass_df$comp_Y_1 <- (cut_compass_df$Y_1 + 10) /2
#create a distance grid measured in feet, based on the computer grid
cut_compass_df$ft_X_1 <- cut_compass_df$comp_X_1 * 132
cut_compass_df$ft_Y_1 <- cut_compass_df$comp_Y_1 * 132
#REVERSE (180) THE BEARINGS SINCE THE MEASUREMENT WAS FROM THE COMPASS TO THE GRID AND X-positive on Grid is 225 relative to north. SO NET IS - 45
cut_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip <-cut_compass_df$Azimuth_1 +135
#polar to cartesian
cut_compass_df$loc_X_1 <- cut_compass_df$ft_X_1+cut_compass_df$Dist_1*sin(cut_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)
cut_compass_df$loc_Y_1 <- cut_compass_df$ft_Y_1+cut_compass_df$Dist_1*cos(cut_compass_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)

plot(por_compass_df$ft_X_1,por_compass_df$ft_Y_1,xlim=c(0,1800),ylim=c(0,1800))
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_2,por_compass_df$ft_Y_2)
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_3,por_compass_df$ft_Y_3)
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_4,por_compass_df$ft_Y_4)
points(cut_compass_df$loc_X_1,cut_compass_df$loc_Y_1, col="red")
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_ave,por_compass_df$ft_Y_ave,col="blue", cex=2)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
subplot_df$comp_X_1 <- (-(subplot_df$chain_x /2))+17 
subplot_df$comp_Y_1 <- (subplot_df$chain_y + 10) /2
subplot_df$comp_X_2 <- (-(subplot_df$chain_x2 /2))+17 
subplot_df$comp_Y_2 <- (subplot_df$chain_y2 + 10) /2
subplot_df$comp_X_New <- (-(subplot_df$nchain_x /2))+17 
subplot_df$comp_Y_New <- (subplot_df$nchain_y + 10) /2
##create a distance grid measured in feet, based on the computer grid
subplot_df$ft_X_1 <- subplot_df$comp_X_1 * 132
subplot_df$ft_Y_1 <- subplot_df$comp_Y_1 * 132
subplot_df$ft_X_2 <- subplot_df$comp_X_2 * 132
subplot_df$ft_Y_2 <- subplot_df$comp_Y_2 * 132
subplot_df$ft_X_New <- subplot_df$comp_X_New * 132
subplot_df$ft_Y_New <- subplot_df$comp_Y_New * 132

subplot_df$Azimuth_1_flip <-subplot_df$azi +135
subplot_df$Azimuth_2_flip <-subplot_df$azi2 +135
subplot_df$Azimuth_New_flip <-subplot_df$nazi +135

##polar to cartesian
subplot_df$loc_X_1 <- subplot_df$ft_X_1+subplot_df$ft*sin(subplot_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)
subplot_df$loc_Y_1 <- subplot_df$ft_Y_1+subplot_df$ft*cos(subplot_df$Azimuth_1_flip*pi/180)
subplot_df$loc_X_2 <- subplot_df$ft_X_2+subplot_df$ft2*sin(subplot_df$Azimuth_2_flip*pi/180)
subplot_df$loc_Y_2 <- subplot_df$ft_Y_2+subplot_df$ft2*cos(subplot_df$Azimuth_2_flip*pi/180)
subplot_df$loc_X_New <- subplot_df$ft_X_New+subplot_df$nft*sin(subplot_df$Azimuth_New_flip*pi/180)
subplot_df$loc_Y_New <- subplot_df$ft_Y_New+subplot_df$nft*cos(subplot_df$Azimuth_New_flip*pi/180)

plot(por_compass_df$ft_X_1,por_compass_df$ft_Y_1,xlim=c(100,600),ylim=c(100,600))
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_2,por_compass_df$ft_Y_2)
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_3,por_compass_df$ft_Y_3)
points(por_compass_df$ft_X_4,por_compass_df$ft_Y_4)
points(subplot_df$loc_X_1,subplot_df$loc_Y_1, col="green", cex=2)
points(subplot_df$loc_X_2,subplot_df$loc_Y_2, col="orange", cex=2)
points(subplot_df$loc_X_New,subplot_df$loc_Y_New,col="blue", cex=2)
```
